Cadastral map showing lot and block numbers, lot and block dimensions.

Cadastral map showing lot and block numbers, lot and block dimensions. Covers area around Lincoln Park bounded by C St. N.E., 19th St. N.E. and S.E., E St. S.E., 17th St. S.E., K St. S.E., and 11th St. S.E. and N.E. Includes "Sales list" table. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy fold-lined, trimmed, mounted on cloth backing, and annotated in faded blue ink in sales list table. DCP
Contributors: Francis R. Fava, Jr., & Co; Walter, John H.
